about: The evangelium of the formulary “23rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, as Jesus was speaking to the crowds, behold, a certain ruler came up and worshiped Him, saying: “Lord, my daughter has just now died; but come, lay Your hand upon her, and she will live.” And Jesus rose and followed him, with His disciples. And behold, a woman who had suffered from a flow of blood for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His garment; for she said within herself: “If I only touch His garment, I shall be healed.” But Jesus turned, and seeing her He said: “Have confidence, daughter; your faith has healed you.” And the woman was healed from that hour. And when Jesus had come into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the noisy crowd, He said: “Go away, for the girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they ridiculed Him. And when the crowd had been put out, He went in and took hold of her hand, and the girl rose up. And this report went forth into all that country.
